seo.title: Pricing — Managed Website Plans | SynergyFirst Digital
seo.metaDescription: Compare SynergyFirst Digital's managed website plans in USD — Lite, Business and E-Commerce — including inclusions, domain ownership and cancellation terms.
seo.ogDescription: Compare managed website plans, inclusions and terms in USD.

h1: Plans built to grow with your business

sections.subheading: Every plan includes hosting, maintenance and a defined content-update allowance — nothing hidden behind vague wording.

sections.heading: Compare plans
sections.intro: Every plan is billed monthly in USD, with no activation fee and no long-term contract — see exactly what's included below.

note.body: Cancel anytime — you stay because you're getting value, not because you're locked in.

customPlan.heading: Need something different?
customPlan.body: One-time project, SEO-only, AI integration, or something we haven't thought of yet — apply and tell us what you need, and we'll confirm whether we can build a plan that fits.

sections.heading: Included on every plan
sections.intro: Regardless of which plan you choose, these are never an upsell.

items.title: Custom design
items.body: Every site is designed for your business — no drag-and-drop templates.

items.title: Domain, hosting & security
items.body: Domain connection, managed hosting, SSL and monthly uptime monitoring, included.

items.title: Mobile-responsive by default
items.body: Every page is built to work correctly on phones, tablets and desktops.

items.title: Ongoing content-update support
items.body: A defined monthly update allowance keeps your site current, without a separate maintenance contract.

items.title: Domain ownership
items.body: You always own your domain, regardless of plan or how long you subscribe.

items.title: Minimum term
items.body: Month-to-month billing with no long-term contract and no activation fee — cancel anytime.

items.title: Buyout / transfer policy
items.body: Our source-code and content buyout or transfer policy is being finalized (TBD) and will be published before launch.

items.title: Add-ons & third-party charges
items.body: Additional Google Workspace email addresses are $15/month each beyond your plan's included allowance; other third-party charges are passed through at cost.

sections.heading: Not sure which plan fits?
sections.body: Apply for a free preview or Book a Free 30-Minute Discovery Call — we'll help you figure out what you actually need.
